cases.question: Find companies globally with revenue above $5B, gross margin over 60%, operating margin over 25%, and net debt/EBITDA under 1.0x.
cases.result_summary: count=40 global. Top: NVDA, GOOG, MSFT, 2330.TW, META, MU, 000660.KO, V. Per-metric evidence in matched.financial for all 4 (revenue unit=usd e.g. NVDA 253.5B; gross_margin 0.7415; operating_margin 0.6402; net_debt_ebitda -0.0046 w/ net_debt_usd=-889M confirming NET debt not gross).
cases.reason: All four conditions intersected, revenue as absolute USD line item, net_debt_ebitda uses net debt, global scope, per-metric evidence returned.

cases.question: หาหุ้นที่มีรายได้เติบโต YoY ติดต่อกันอย่างน้อย 5 ปี และ EPS ก็โตทุกปี รายได้เกิน 1 พันล้านดอลลาร์ (consecutive 5yr revenue AND EPS growth, revenue>$1B).
cases.result_summary: Correct query built: consecutive_growth (min_yoy = each year positive, NOT CAGR — verified via matched window 'min_yoy_4y') on BOTH revenue AND eps_diluted, N=5, revenue>$1B. Result count=0. Diagnosis: (a) revenue consecutive_growth N=5 alone = 0 while N=4=5 hits, N=3=12 — data history only supports ~4 consecutive YoY years; (b) ANY eps consecutive_growth leg TIMES OUT (read timeout, backend). Best achievable substitute (rev consec N=4 + rev>1B) = 5 hits.
cases.reason: Correct construction & pattern semantics, but unanswerable: 5-consecutive-years exceeds ~4yr data coverage AND the EPS-consecutive backend path times out — the joint screen returns 0.

defects.desc: eps_diluted (and eps_basic) with pattern consecutive_growth times out (server read timeout) for any N; revenue consecutive_growth is fast — EPS consecutive-growth path is a perf defect
consecutive_growth N>=5 always returns 0 (fundamentals history ~4-5yr) — a 5-consecutive-YoY-growth screen is silently unsatisfiable; no message telling the caller the window exceeds coverage

cases.question: Compare Toyota, Volkswagen, GM on revenue, net income, operating margin, ROE, net debt — all in USD. Strongest balance sheet?
cases.result_summary: financials returned all 3 with explicit [USD] normalization tag. Toyota(7203.JP) rev 336.9B USD, net_debt_ebitda 3.87, D/E 1.18, ROE 12%, op margin 7%; VW(VOW.XETRA) rev 364.1B USD, D/E 1.1, FCF -10.6B; GM(GM.US) USD. Ratios (op margin/ROE) currency-neutral. Enough to judge strongest balance sheet on net debt/leverage.
cases.reason: Absolute figures converted to common USD basis (tagged [USD]) from JPY/EUR/USD reporting currencies; ratios comparable directly; leverage figures support a balance-sheet judgment.

cases.question: Below sector-average P/E but above sector-average ROE — US large caps.
cases.result_summary: count=28, universe=130 (US large cap). Both legs matched with kind='cohort' (e.g. GOOG pe cohort 17.12, roe cohort 0.3813) — evaluated against a peer benchmark, not fixed thresholds. Results: GOOG, META, MU, ORCL, HD, PG, NFLX, SNDK.
cases.reason: Cohort-relative (kind=cohort) below-avg P/E AND above-avg ROE intersected, scoped to US large-cap.

cases.question: Accelerating revenue growth — growth rate rising over three periods (g_t > g_{t-1} > g_{t-2}).
cases.result_summary: count=40. Pattern 'accelerating' (resolver: 'min consecutive periods speeding up / accel_streak', default N=2) — distinct from consecutive_growth/high-growth. Top: AAPL, GOOG, META, LLY, AMD, ABBV, PLTR, ORCL.
cases.reason: Dedicated 'accelerating' pattern captures rising YoY growth rate (2nd derivative), not merely positive/high growth; correctly resolved and applied.

cases.question: Profitable software companies: FCF > $500M, FCF yield > 4%, net cash (cash > total debt). Any market.
cases.result_summary: First attempt used cash higher_than total_debt (relation form) -> TIMED OUT. Retried with net_debt is_negative (== cash>total_debt, the standard net-cash def): count=17, universe=1563 (software gics 4510). FCF unit=usd (>500M), fcf_yield ratio distinct (e.g. ACN 12.1%), net_debt<0 confirms net cash, net_income is_positive = profitable. Results: SAP, ACN, 9999.HK NetEase, INFY, 6701.JP NEC, DSY.PA, ZM, DT.
cases.reason: FCF absolute-$ and FCF-yield ratio treated as distinct conditions; 'net cash' = negative net debt (cash>debt) not merely positive cash; software + profitable, global. (Relation form timed out but net_debt is_negative is the correct equivalent.)

defects.desc: RELATION form (metricA cash / higher_than / metricB total_debt) times out in screen_unified

cases.question: Expanding margins: gross, operating AND net margin all higher today than 3 years ago (trend, not level).

args.q: higher now than three years ago (net increase over period)

cases.result_summary: Correct construction: change over 3y (compound_growth N=3, threshold 0 = net higher than 3y ago, level-agnostic) on all 3 margins jointly. 3-leg intersection TIMES OUT (whole-market AND scoped to large/mega). Single-leg gross_margin compound_growth works (count=20: NVDA/AAPL/GOOG/AMZN/2330). improved_every_year also times out.
cases.reason: Query is correct (Δ over 3y, no absolute threshold, all 3 margins intersected) but the 3-way margin growth-series intersection times out in the backend even when scoped — cannot return the answer.

defects.desc: Multi-leg growth-series intersection (compound_growth / improved_every_year on ratios) times out even scoped to large/mega caps; single-leg is fast — growth-series scan doesn't scale to intersections

cases.question: ขอบริษัทในเอเชีย ROIC เกิน 15% ต่อเนื่อง, D/E ต่ำกว่า 0.5, current ratio มากกว่า 2 (Asia, quality + balance sheet).
cases.result_summary: count=40, universe=16989 (Asia). All 3 intersected w/ per-metric evidence: 2330.TW roic 0.50/DE 0.15/CR 2.46; Samsung roic 0.20/DE 0.06/CR 2.54; Kweichow Moutai roic 0.42/DE 0.0009/CR 7.06; SK Hynix, Advantest, Fast Retailing. ROIC used (not ROE); D/E & current ratio currency-neutral.
cases.reason: ROIC>15% AND D/E<0.5 AND current ratio>2 intersected, scoped to Asia; ROIC correctly used, balance-sheet condition kept.

defects.desc: 'ต่อเนื่อง/sustained' ROIC applied as latest-level above 0.15 rather than multi-year (a consecutive ROIC leg would hit the same growth-series timeout); acceptable interpretation but not literally multi-year

cases.question: Revenue > $10B, R&D > $2B/yr, and R&D as % of revenue > 15%.

args.q: R&D as percent of revenue R&D intensity

cases.result_summary: Two absolute-$ legs work (revenue>$10B AND rnd>$2B, both unit=usd): count=40 (NVDA rnd 20.8B/rev 253B, META 71.6B/228B, TSLA 7.7B/103B, etc). The 15% INTENSITY gate cannot be applied: no rnd_to_revenue ratio concept exists, and the RELATION form (rnd higher_than revenue*0.15) returns count=0 — verified BROKEN (even gross_profit higher_than revenue*0.5 returns 0, which should match many). Without the gate, sub-15% names (NVDA 8.2%, TSLA 7.5%) wrongly pass.
cases.reason: Absolute-$ revenue and R&D floors correct & USD-normalized, but the essential R&D-intensity>15% condition is unenforceable — no ratio concept and the relation form silently returns 0.

defects.desc: RELATION form 'metricA higher_than metricB' with a multiple silently returns count=0 for cases that clearly should match (rnd>=0.15*rev, even gross_profit>=0.5*rev) — the ratio-of-two-line-items comparison is broken in screen_unified
No R&D-intensity (rnd/revenue) ratio concept in find_fsconcept, so an R&D% gate has no direct metric path

cases.question: Compounders: 3y revenue CAGR>20%, EPS CAGR>25%, ROE consistently >20%, net debt/EBITDA<2x. Global.
cases.result_summary: count=40. All 4 intersected w/ per-metric evidence over SAME window: revenue 3y_cagr & eps_diluted 3y_cagr (NVDA rev 1.00/eps 2.04; SK Hynix rev 0.30/eps 1.65; ANET rev 0.27/eps 0.37), roe level>0.20, net_debt_ebitda level<2 using net debt (NVDA -0.005, ANET -0.49). EPS CAGR>rev CAGR holds (margin leverage). Global.
cases.reason: Revenue & EPS CAGR over the same 3y window, ROE>20% level, net_debt_ebitda (net debt) <2x, all intersected globally with evidence; EPS-faster-than-revenue relation holds in results.

defects.desc: EPS compound_growth (CAGR) is fast and works, in contrast to EPS consecutive_growth which times out (fe-02) — the timeout is specific to the consecutive/every-year path, not all EPS growth

top_defects: screen_unified RELATION form (metricA higher_than metricB, incl. with a multiple) silently returns count=0 even for cases that clearly match — breaks 'net cash' (fe-06) and R&D-intensity/EPS>rev-growth style comparisons (fe-09)
Multi-leg growth-series intersections (compound_growth / consecutive_growth / improved_every_year across 2-3 fund legs, and any EPS consecutive_growth) time out even when scoped — fe-02, fe-07
consecutive_growth N>=5 silently returns 0 (fundamentals history ~4-5yr) with no message that the window exceeds data coverage — fe-02
